method.comparison: Assess actual delivered news drafts against supplied synthetic requirements; no full-text equality to an expected final draft.
method.length: Exclude the two optional titles and the heading that labels the body. Count Unicode Script=Han code points separately from all non-whitespace body code points; digits, Latin letters and punctuation count only in the latter.
method.verdictPolicy: Only call length definitely non-compliant if both counts fall outside the required range in the same direction. Divergent readings are NEEDS_DEFINITION.
method.unknowns: No inference about group, optimizer, executor, or an undisclosed expected draft.
